findings.title: [P1] Restrict post-login redirects to trusted paths
findings.body: When `returnUrl` is attacker-controlled, passing it directly to `location.assign` permits redirects to arbitrary origins, enabling trusted-domain phishing after login. Validate that it is an allowed same-origin path before navigating.

findings.title: [P1] Stop writing issued tokens to audit logs
findings.body: Whenever `recordIssuedToken` is called with a live credential, the complete token reaches `console.log`. Collected logs commonly have broader access and retention than credentials, allowing anyone with log access to replay the token before expiration. Record non-sensitive metadata or a redacted identifier instead.

findings.title: [P2] Restrict post-login redirects to trusted same-origin paths
findings.body:
If an attacker controls `returnUrl`, values such as `https://attacker.example` redirect authenticated users to an arbitrary origin, enabling trusted-domain phishing and open-redirect abuse.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Stop writing issued tokens to audit logs
findings.body:
Every call with a live bearer/session token passes the complete credential to `console.log`. In environments that collect console output, anyone with log access can recover and replay tokens until they expire.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restrict login redirects to trusted same-origin URLs
findings.body:
If an attacker controls `returnUrl`, values such as `https://evil.example` create an open redirect, while `javascript:...` can execute script in the application's origin where CSP permits it, potentially compromising the authenticated session.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Redact issued tokens from audit output
findings.body:
Every issued token is written verbatim to `console.log`. In environments that collect stdout or expose console output to broader operators/processes, a valid bearer token can be recovered and replayed before expiry.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
